product: BRASPACE screen-background terrain derived from NASA LOLA (visual context; not illumination, not visibility)

shading.note: shading light is synthetic, not a real illumination state

projection.type: polar stereographic (spherical), true scale at the pole

transform.pixel_convention: zero-indexed image coordinates, col to the right, row downwards; integer col/row is a pixel centre, pixel edges at +-0.5
transform.forward: rho = 2*R*tan(radians(90+lat)/2); x = rho*sin(radians(lon)); y = rho*cos(radians(lon)); col = pole_col + x/meters_per_pixel; row = pole_row - y/meters_per_pixel
transform.inverse: x = (col-pole_col)*meters_per_pixel; y = (pole_row-row)*meters_per_pixel; rho = hypot(x,y); lat = degrees(2*atan(rho/(2*R))) - 90; lon = degrees(atan2(x,y))
transform.orientation: 0°E up, 90°E right, 180°E down, 90°W left (viewed from above the south pole)
transform.dem_pixel_of_image_pixel: dem_col = 5*col + 1442.0, same for row (zero-indexed LDEM_80S_80M pixel centres)

credit: Elevation: NASA/GSFC/LOLA (LRO LOLA LDEM_80S_80M). Rendering: BRASPACE.
